meta.via: county, city and agency websites; DSHS EMS provider roster 2026-10-02 for licence cross-check (local sources)

services.name: Montgomery County Hospital District EMS (MCHD)
services.evidence: MCHD operates the county's 911 ambulance service, manages the county's Public Health District and offers a variety of community and professional education programs.

services.name: Houston Fire Department
services.area: City of Houston limits within Montgomery County (Kingwood/Lake Houston fringe)
services.evidence: We operate over 100 ambulances and transport units staffed by highly trained paramedics.

48339.page_note: Confirmed: Montgomery County Hospital District (MCHD) runs the county's 911 ambulance service. Not yet confirmed from a public source: who transports in the part of the City of Houston inside the county.
48339.second_source: https://www.fisdap.net/blog/pdfs/2022/07/07/customer-spotlight-q-a-montgomery-county-hospital-district (search result, not opened: MCHD-EMS is the 911 EMS provider for Montgomery County, 1,100 sq mi)

services.name: San Angelo Fire Department
services.evidence: The SAFD provides ambulance service to all of Tom Green County, responding to more than 12,500 ambulance calls a year. The Fire Department's EMS provides advanced life support and transports patients to medical facilities within Tom Green County.

48451.page_note: San Angelo Fire Department provides ground 911 ambulance service to all of Tom Green County; the city's private ambulance permits are for non-emergencies only.

services.name: Odessa Fire Rescue
services.area: whole county (904 sq mi; Ector County is ~901 sq mi)
services.evidence: Odessa Fire Rescue has provided emergency medical services since 1973 ... Operates : 9 Mobile Intensive Care Unit ambulances and 5 reserves ... Covers 904 square miles and serves about 200,000 people

48135.page_note: Confirmed: Odessa Fire Rescue transports in Odessa. Not yet confirmed from a public source: who serves the rest of the county since two new emergency services districts formed in 2025.

48201.page_note: 41 fire departments, city services, emergency services districts and private services hold 911 ambulance licences based in the county; each one's area is not yet confirmed. Confirmed: Houston Fire Department, which reports 'over 100 ambulances and transport units'. Not yet confirmed from a public source: the 911 role of private services licensed for both 911 and transfer, such as Cypress Creek EMS, Windsor EMS and Health Quest EMS.

48113.page_note: The state's 911 ambulance licence list names 26 services in the county, mostly city fire departments, including Dallas, Garland, Irving, Mesquite and Richardson. Each city fire department listed runs its own ambulances. Not yet confirmed from a public source: each department's coverage area, and the roles of CareFlite and Texas Regional EMS.

48439.page_note: The state's 911 ambulance licence list names 26 services in the county, including MedStar, AMR (Arlington and Tarrant/Ellis County), Fort Worth Fire Department, about 20 other city fire departments and Tarrant County ESD 1. Not yet confirmed from a public source: each service's coverage area.

48029.page_note: 13 services hold 911 ambulance licences in the county, including San Antonio Fire Department EMS, suburban fire departments and Bexar County emergency services districts; each one's area is not yet confirmed. Not yet confirmed from a public source: the 911 role of the private services Lone Star Ambulance, Arclight Mobile Integrated Healthcare and SuperiorCare Ambulance.

48453.page_note: Austin-Travis County EMS serves over 1,300 square miles, including all of Travis County and parts of Williamson and Hays Counties (city of Austin website). Pflugerville moved ambulance service from Allegiance Mobile Health to Travis County ESD 2 effective Oct. 1, 2026 (Community Impact, July 15, 2026). Not yet confirmed from a public source: the roles of Travis County ESD 1 (Lago Vista) and ESD 11, which hold 911 licences, and of the Acadian and AMR Austin licences.

48491.page_note: Williamson County EMS provides 911 emergency medical services across 1,100 square miles with 21 ambulances (county website, archived 2025). Georgetown Fire Department runs ambulances for the city and ESD 8, Austin-Travis County EMS serves parts of the county, and Travis County ESD 2 has served the city of Pflugerville (a small part is in Williamson) since Oct. 1, 2026. Not yet confirmed from a public source: whether the private ambulances Georgetown franchised for backup EMS in 2015 are still in place.

48085.page_note: The state's 911 ambulance licence list names 12 cities and towns in the county, including Plano, Frisco, McKinney and Allen. Not yet confirmed from a public source: coverage of unincorporated areas, and the parts of Dallas, Richardson and Wylie that lie in the county.

48121.page_note: 19 fire departments, city services, an emergency services district and two private services (Akin Ambulance and Sacred Cross EMS) hold 911 ambulance licences in the county, including Denton, Flower Mound and Lewisville; each one's area is not yet confirmed.

48157.page_note: A 2020 county memo names Fort Bend County EMS as the countywide base, with Sugar Land Fire-EMS (its own EMS since 2015), Katy Fire/EMS, Harris County ESD 48 and ESD 100/Community VFD as 911 EMS providers; the Houston city portion is served by Houston Fire Department. Not yet confirmed from a public source: whether this is still current, and the 911 roles of First Medical Response and Healthsource.

48215.page_note: 14 city fire/EMS departments and private services hold 911 ambulance licences in the county, including Alton, Mission, Palmview, Pharr, La Joya, Mercedes and Weslaco; many are private. Not yet confirmed from a public source: each one's area and the city contracts.

48141.page_note: Six services hold 911 ambulance licences in the county: El Paso Fire Department, University Medical Center of El Paso, Dominion Ambulance, Elite Medical Transport, Life Ambulance Service and Emergent Air. El Paso Fire Department serves the city. Not yet confirmed from a public source: who serves the rest of the county, including emergency services district contractors.

48329.page_note: Midland Fire Department says it 'responds to fire and EMS calls inside the city of Midland and throughout the county' (city news release, Aug 19, 2025). Not yet confirmed from a public source: that the department transports patients, since the page mentions only EMS billing, and who serves the part of Odessa inside Midland County (Odessa Fire Rescue is not confirmed).

48423.page_note: UT Health East Texas EMS says it serves 'all of Henderson and Panola Counties, most of Smith, Cherokee and Wood Counties'. Not yet confirmed from a public source: who serves the rest of Smith County.

services.name: Wise County EMS
services.evidence: Wise County EMS Rescue provides emergency pre-hospital care as well as critical care transfers for the entire county.
services.vintage: 2026 (page live 2026-10-22; Wise County Messenger 2026-09-12 and 2026-10-19 name the Wise County EMS chief and Medic units transporting patients)

48497.page_note: Wise County EMS, a county department based in Decatur, provides emergency ambulance care and transfers for the entire county. It is the only ambulance service licensed by the state in Wise County; Justin Fire Department (Denton County) is a neighbouring first-response unit and no transport by it inside Wise County was found. City fire departments such as Decatur and Rhome give first response and Wise County EMS transports.
48497.second_source: https://www.wcmessenger.com/articles/5-injured-3-critically-in-fm-51-head-on-crash/ (2026-09-12: "Wise County EMS later transported the patient by ground to Medical City Decatur. Medic-1 transported 2 patients to Medical City Decatur"); https://www.wcmessenger.com/articles/hospital-partnership-advances-decatur-fire-departments-ems-capabilities/ (2024-12-11: Decatur Fire Department is not going into patient transport; Wise County EMS transports)

services.name: Austin County EMS
services.evidence: Austin County EMS is the sole 911 emergency medical provider for all 656 square miles of Austin County.
services.vintage: 2025 (about-us page: "In April 2025, Austin County proudly implemented new SDO/Guidelines"; page live 2026-10-22)

48015.page_note: Austin County EMS, a county service based in Bellville with stations in Bellville, Sealy, Wallis and Industry, says it is the sole 911 emergency medical provider for the whole county. The other licensed ambulance company in the county (Holiness & Brothers EMS, Sealy) is licensed for non-emergency transfers only. The Sealy Fire Department provides medical first response, not ambulance transport.
48015.second_source: https://www.austincounty.com/page/austin.EMS (county site lists EMS and links to austincountyems.com); https://sealyfire.com/about/ (Sealy Fire Department, Austin County ESD No. 2, provides fire response and "emergency medical assists")

services.name: Washington County EMS
services.evidence: The department believes in a maintaining a comprehensive system that is capable of handling 911 calls, Emergency Transfers, Critical Care Services, Non-emergency transfers, and even Rescue Paramedic Services to the visitors and residents of Washington County.
services.vintage: 2026 (page live 2026-10-22; City of Brenham post 2026-08-22: "two people were transported by Washington County EMS")

48477.page_note: Washington County EMS, a county department based in Brenham with a service area of about 700 square miles, handles 911 calls and emergency transfers for the county. It is the only ambulance service licensed by the state in Washington County; Brenham has no city ambulance licence.
48477.second_source: https://www.aol.com/articles/2-injured-plane-crash-brenham-152344000.html (2026-08-22: "two people were transported by Washington County EMS with minor injuries"); county FY2027 adopted budget has an EMS section (pages 31-33); Washington County EMS strategic plan linked from the county site (https://app.smore.com/n/5xz2fc-ems-strategic-planning-document) reports its countywide response time; Brenham Fire Department works with Washington County EMS at entrapment scenes (cityofbrenham.org fire history page)

services.name: Cooke County EMS
services.evidence: Cooke County EMS is a department within the government of Cooke County in North Texas. We are located directly off of Interstate 35. Bordered by the Red River, Grayson County, Montague County and Denton County, we cover approximately 900 square miles.
services.vintage: 2026 (page live 2026-10-22; EMS protocols effective 2026-03-05: "Cooke County Emergency Medical Services covers 874 Sq. Miles of Cooke County ... the transporting unit will contact the destination hospital"; FY2027 adopted budget carries ambulance fee revenue)

48097.page_note: Cooke County EMS, a county department based in Gainesville, covers the whole county and transports patients. It is the only ambulance service licensed by the state in Cooke County; Gainesville has no city ambulance licence. Gainesville Fire-Rescue and the volunteer fire departments respond as medical first responders; the county 911 center dispatches Cooke County EMS.
48097.second_source: https://newtools.cira.state.tx.us/upload/page/3110/docs/2026CookeCountyEMSProtocols.pdf; https://www.co.cooke.tx.us/page/cooke.SheriffComm (county 911 Communications: "handles 911 emergency services and provides dispatch services for ... EMS", listing Cooke County Emergency Medical Services as the only EMS agency); https://www.gainesville.tx.us/1284/About-Us (Gainesville Fire-Rescue provides "medical first responder" services)
